presentation.label: BEAT SLICER
presentation.summary: Development draft: preview beat-spaced slice starts from sample or project BPM.
presentation.overview: A tested portable planning core, not an installed Octatrack module. Native editor, persistence, playback fade and USB integration are pending.
highlights: Choose sample BPM or project BPM.
Retain existing markers and inspect stereo boundary amplitude.
usage: Not installable yet. See README.md for the proposed editor workflow and integration blockers.

controls.name: BPM SOURCE
controls.doc: Proposed dialog: use the sample ATTR BPM or the project BPM captured at preview. No silent fallback.

controls.name: SPACING
controls.doc: Proposed dialog: beat spacing, anchored at trim start. A beat is a quarter note.

controls.name: BOUNDARY
controls.doc: Proposed dialog: exact grid or a stereo-aware quiet-boundary search within 2 ms. This does not guarantee click-free playback.

limitations: Development draft, not listed or installable.
No native slice-editor event/adapter, stock persistence integration or USB package exists yet.
No audio playback or MKII hardware verification; click-free playback is not established.
Planner accepts BPM 30–300 in 1/24 BPM units, signed 24-bit mono/stereo decoded PCM, 8–192 kHz, at most 64 slice starts.
Sample/project identity, live preview invalidation, sample-file saving and Undo must be implemented by the adapter.

tests.summary: 18 original/independent host tests, 164 compiled synchronous planner vectors, six isolated editor CPU probes and five synthetic-IO stock storage probe groups pass. Resumable preview adds 500 host and 100 target comparisons plus lifecycle checks. No full editor, USB, audio or physical persistence qualification.
gates: verify.py deliberately refuses qualification until native/UI/USB/audio/persistence integration is verified

license.declaration: Original planning core and synthetic tests. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps included.

access.location: Proposed MKII audio editor SLICE menu; unavailable in firmware
steps: Pending native integration: select a Flex or Static audio track and open AED.
Proposed: press LFO for SLICE, FUNC + YES for its menu, then select BEAT GRID. Stock menu integration is not verified.
Choose BPM SOURCE, SPACING and BOUNDARY, preview the marker count and warnings, then explicitly Apply or Cancel. Do not use this proposal as instructions for an existing build.
